query: After an import fails, what happens to lookup and deleted review records when a rescan succeeds?

source_chunks.heading: Recovery procedure
source_chunks.content: If an import fails, retain the previous snapshot. Disable new evidence lookup until a successful rescan. A successful rescan re-enables lookup. Previously deleted review records remain deleted after rescan.
source_chunks.uncertainty: Source text has not been reviewed.

limitations: Results reflect indexed snapshots; disk changes need a rescan.
Word overlap does not establish relevance or entailment.
At most 200 candidates per evidence kind are examined.
result.matching: case-insensitive whole-word overlap ranked by distinct shared terms
